key_highlights: ASX set to fall sharply on Wall Street declines and Iran war escalation; oil hovering near US$100/barrel
Iron ore weakness spreading through global markets, pressuring BHP, RIO, FMG
RBA policy dilemma: 'choosing recession' as business conditions hit weakest since pandemic
Home buyer sentiment collapses; high-end property sees steepest falls while affordable end resilient
Bathla collapse ripples through private credit market, raising systemic risk concerns
WA gold sector surges with multiple high-grade discoveries (Auric, Golden Dragon, Forrestania, Gateway)
Copper prices soaring; Flagship ups Canadian copper stakes
Qantas fires workers with $35m payout; ATO opens tax battle against Big Tech
Power giant seeks AI data centre development at coal plants; NSW energy supply concerns

sectors.trend: Iron ore in severe downtrend ('drowning, not waving'); copper and gold counter-trending strongly. WA gold discoveries driving junior explorer activity. Flagship expanding copper exposure.
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX face headwinds from iron ore weakness and China's reduced patience with Trump tariffs. Gold juniors (Auric, Golden Dragon, Forrestania, Gateway) attract capital rotation. Copper upside supports BHP.AX, FMG.AX partially.

sectors.trend: Oil near US$100 on Iran war escalation; 'next oil crunch' feared. Power giant pivoting coal plants to AI data centres. NSW energy supply under strain.
sectors.implications: Woodside (WDS.AX), Santos (STO.AX) benefit from oil spike. Coal-to-data-centre pivot (likely AGL.AX or Origin ORG.AX) signals structural energy demand shift. NSW power shortfall risks brownouts.

sectors.trend: Bathla collapse ripples through private credit; RBA faces recession vs inflation dilemma. ATO vs Big Tech tax dispute adds regulatory uncertainty.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX face credit risk from private credit contagion. RBA 'choosing recession' implies rate cut pressure, supportive for banks' NIM but risky for asset quality. ATO action pressures tech valuations.

sectors.trend: Cancer patient out-of-pocket costs rising; 12-month colonoscopy waits; Novartis pipeline setbacks; Boston Scientific cyberattack disrupts 2026 guidance.
sectors.implications: CSL.AX, SGH.AX face policy pressure on patient costs. International pharma setbacks (Novartis, BSC) may redirect capital to ASX-listed CSL.AX, SSW.AX. Healthcare infrastructure strain supports private hospital operators.

sectors.trend: Qantas workforce dispute ($35m payout); business conditions weakest since pandemic; small businesses squeezed by postage fees; coastal property $850b reckoning.
sectors.implications: QAN.AX faces ongoing labour cost pressure. WES.AX, WOW.AX under pressure from weak consumer sentiment. REITs (GPW.AX, ICPL.AX) face coastal property devaluation risk.

sectors.trend: Austal jumps on US$1.9b bid; AI data centre demand reshaping energy; ATO vs Big Tech; Block underperforming Nasdaq.
sectors.implications: Austal (AUS.AX) M&A activity signals consolidation. Data centre build-out supports AGL.AX, ORG.AX, and infrastructure names. Block (BX.AX) underperformance vs Nasdaq warrants review.

key_themes: Iran war escalation driving oil to US$100, creating inflationary pressure and RBA policy conflict
Iron ore structural weakness vs gold/copper strength – commodity rotation underway
Housing market bifurcation: high-end collapse vs affordable resilience; buyer sentiment at lows
Private credit contagion (Bathla) raising systemic financial stability concerns
RBA caught between recession risk and inflation from energy shock
AI data centre demand creating new energy infrastructure investment thesis
China-USA trade tensions (China 'run out of patience') threatening commodity demand
Business conditions at pandemic lows – broad-based economic deterioration

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Iran war escalation / oil supply shock
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge energy exposure; favour oil producers (WDS.AX, STO.AX); reduce oil-intensive consumer names

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Iron ore demand collapse / China slowdown
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX weightings; rotate into gold and copper exposure

risk_assessment.risk_factor: RBA forced into recessionary policy / credit contagion
risk_assessment.mitigation: Monitor RBA statements; reduce leverage; favour quality financials (CBA.AX) over private credit exposure
Avoid high-end property REITs; favour affordable-segment and industrial REITs

risk_assessment.risk_factor: NSW energy supply shortfall / data centre demand
risk_assessment.mitigation: Favour power generators with data centre contracts; monitor AGL.AX, ORG.AX, AEMO data

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Qantas labour dispute / transport sector instability
risk_assessment.mitigation: Avoid QAN.AX near-term; monitor for resolution catalyst

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight oil & gas producers on Iran war oil spike
opportunities.rationale: Oil near US$100 with escalation risk; WDS and STO benefit directly from supply disruption premium

opportunities.recommendation: Rotate into WA gold juniors on discovery wave
opportunities.rationale: Multiple high-grade hits (Auric 102koz, Golden Dragon, Forrestania, Gateway $45M) signal sector upcycle; gold hedges inflation from oil shock

opportunities.recommendation: Position in copper-exposed miners on price surge
opportunities.rationale: Copper 'soaring' supports BHP and FMG copper segments; Flagship expansion signals structural demand

opportunities.recommendation: Buy Austal on US$1.9b bid catalyst
opportunities.rationale: M&A event provides near-term re-rating; defence/shipbuilding sector tailwind

opportunities.recommendation: Favour power generators with AI data centre contracts
opportunities.rationale: Coal-to-data-centre pivot creates long-term revenue visibility; NSW energy shortfall supports pricing power

defensive_moves.rationale: Iron ore 'drowning'; China patience running out; structural demand risk from trade tensions

defensive_moves.recommendation: De-risk private credit and high-yield exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: Bathla collapse signals contagion risk; RBA recession path increases default probability

defensive_moves.recommendation: Avoid high-end property REITs; favour industrial/affordable segments
defensive_moves.rationale: Steepest falls at top end; buyer sentiment collapsed; $850b coastal reckoning underway
Iron ore weakness and China tensions pressure AUD; oil spike provides partial offset but net negative for AUD

market_outlook.short_term: ASX under pressure from Wall Street spillover, oil spike, and iron ore weakness. Expect ^AXJO to test support levels. Gold and energy names outperform; iron ore and consumer lag. RBA commentary on recession risk dominates. Bathla fallout may trigger further credit market volatility.
market_outlook.long_term: Commodity rotation from iron ore to gold/copper/energy defines 6-12 month trajectory. Housing bifurcation continues. AI data centre demand creates structural energy investment theme. RBA likely to cut if recession materialises, supporting financials and property long-term. China-USA tensions remain key wildcard for commodity demand.
